description.value: Shiro Japanese Restaurant is a sushi and Japanese cuisine spot on Cambie Street in Vancouver, offering a broad menu spanning nigiri, sashimi, maki rolls, tempura, donburi, and noodles. The restaurant supports online ordering with pickup ready in 30–45 minutes, making it a practical stop for cyclists wanting a quick, satisfying Japanese meal on a key Vancouver cycling corridor.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (4 spaces) at 84m; stands (8 spaces, covered) at 85m. Total: 12 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website successfully loaded and confirms the business name, address (3096 Cambie St, Vancouver, BC), and phone number (604) 874-0027, which was absent from OSM tags. The site shows an active online ordering/pickup system with a full menu, confirming the business is open. No explicit mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any cycling-specific amenities appears in the website content; a 'Vege Roll' menu category provides positive evidence of vegetarian options, and 'Order for Pick-up' confirms takeout service.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; website provides (604) 874-0027 — phone has been added from website source.
